description_en: Disables the Simple Log Service (SLS) log delivery feature for a dedicated resource group
description_zh: 关闭专属资源组SLS日志投递功能
kebab_example: aliyun eas delete-resource-log --cluster-id cn-shanghai --resource-id eas-r-asdas0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteResourceLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the resource group resides
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. Before calling this operation, ensure that log delivery is enabled for the resource group. You can call the DescribeResourceLog operation to query the log status. A Status value of Ready indicates that log delivery is enabled. For more information about how to query the resource group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。调用前请确保该资源组已开启日志投递；可通过 DescribeResourceLog 查询日志状态，Status 为 Ready 表示已开启。如何查询资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.name: resource_id

Message.example: Log service for resource [eas-r-asdas****] is deleting
